_iconNote: icon = Segoe MDL2 Assets glyph codepoint (hex) - the original WPT icon set. The launcher converts it to the glyph and renders it in font-family 'Segoe MDL2 Assets'. A non-hex value (e.g. an emoji) is rendered verbatim.

tools.name: Workstation Patching
tools.summary: Scan, patch (MECM updates/apps), health-check, clean up, and reboot workstations in bulk. The core remediation engine.

tools.name: ACAS Nemesis
tools.summary: Remediate ACAS/Tenable findings: app updates, hardening fixes, reboots.

tools.name: Package Installer
tools.summary: Push and install software packages / fixes to remote machines.

tools.name: Windows Upgrade
tools.summary: Pin/unpin the Windows feature-update target version (gpedit Target Feature Update policy) and push feature-update CAB/MSU packages (DISM) across many workstations. Also diagnoses a failed in-place upgrade: Check Upgrade Errors reads setuperr.log to flag the out-of-memory failure (0x8007000E), and Set Page File applies the 16 GB page-file fix.

tools.name: Unsupported Remediator
tools.summary: Ingest a Tenable/ACAS Unsupported & SEoL report (PDF/CSV), scan the affected hosts, and bulk-uninstall the proven-EOL products. Proven-only gating + dry-run default; Review/Tanium are never auto-removed.

tools.name: Patch Content
tools.summary: Offline patch-content library. Inventories the remediation content already staged for air-gapped use (the repo Packages folder, the work share when reachable, plus an operator extra path) - classifying PSADT packages, MSI / MSU / CAB / EXE bundles and pulling KB ids from filenames - then cross-references it against the KBs you still need (pasted list or an uploaded ACAS CSV) so you know what can be pushed today and what is MISSING. Read-only; touches no hosts.

tools.name: Secure Boot Enabler
tools.summary: Enable UEFI Secure Boot on Dell/HP/Lenovo via SYSTEM scheduled task (WinRM).

tools.name: BIOS Firmware
tools.summary: Read-only fleet BIOS firmware compliance: scan Win32_BIOS over WinRM and score each model Current/Outdated/Unknown against an editable per-model baseline (JanetLocal catalog).

tools.name: STIG Checker
tools.summary: Read-only STIG compliance checker: fan out one consolidated WinRM registry probe per host and score a curated set of Windows 10/11 member-server-safe STIG checks from the editable JanetLocal\stig-baseline.json. Each rule scores Compliant / Open / Error; the host verdict is COMPLIANT, N OPEN, CHECK ERRORS, or OFFLINE. Streams the full per-rule report to the activity log. Changes nothing; needs no admin session.

tools.name: Restart Scheduler
tools.summary: Coordinated fleet reboots: burst-converge on a shared time or roll/go-fast per host, with optional user consent, a never-restart exceptions list, ping + server-skip gates, abort, and reboot verification.

tools.name: Remote Message
tools.summary: Broadcast a popup to logged-on users (e.g. before a patch/reboot wave) across many hosts in parallel.

tools.name: AD Search
tools.summary: Query Active Directory for users, computers, groups, and attributes.

tools.name: DHCP Scope Options
tools.summary: Read and set DHCP scope options across servers/scopes.

tools.name: Reports
tools.summary: Build and export fleet / compliance / remediation reports.

tools.name: KEV Cross-Check
tools.summary: Cross-reference a machine ACAS/ARAD CVE export against the CISA Known Exploited Vulnerabilities (KEV) catalog stored inside JANET (JanetLocal\KevCatalog.txt). Flags the overlap (present AND known-exploited), opens each CVE in Google / NVD / CVE.org / CISA KEV / IAVM lookups, and lets you add new KEV CVEs that persist to the file (ships in take-to-work).

tools.name: C2C Readiness
tools.summary: Read-only Comply-to-Connect (AFI/MPTO rule 3.B.2.B) quarantine predictor: fan out one consolidated WinRM probe per host, run 11 C2C checks (9 scored locally, 2 external/server-side - Vuln + COAMS), and flag each host READY or QUARANTINE RISK. Streams the full per-check report to the activity log. Changes nothing; needs no admin session. Baseline is the editable JanetLocal\c2c-baseline.json.

tools.name: Patch History
tools.summary: Read-only Patch History / Audit Explorer over the audit trail JANET already writes (per-tool monthly detail CSVs, TouchedHosts attribution, and the fleet usage rollup on the 445-gated central log share, with local-spool fallback when it is down). Four tabs: per-host Timeline, Recent Activity across all tools, per-operator Summary, and a Staleness board (paste hosts -> FRESH / STALE / NEVER TOUCHED against a threshold). Touches no hosts and writes nothing.

tools.name: Beta Lab
tools.summary: Experimental, read-only fleet features. None are active right now; new sections land here as they bake, then graduate into their own tool.
